title: A demo host runs at most DEMO_INSTALL_SLOTS demo installs at once; the rest queue with 'waiting for a free install slot', customers never wait
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-host/test/provision.test.mjs apps/tracy-host/test/config.test.mjs
S2: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set, run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/ops-demos.test.mjs
S3: Read the exit code and the fail/skipped counts of each run.
expect: Every run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests.

With demoInstallSlots 2, four demo provisions all answer 202; two run; the third reads state queued, step 'waiting for a free install slot (next)', the fourth '(1 ahead)'; when the first ends the third starts.
With one slot taken by demos, a provision without demo:true starts at once.
The demo door's /_host/provision body carries demo: true.
evidence: fleet01, 12/10/2026: 14 demo redeploys ran provision.sh at once on 2 cores; steps frozen from 16:54Z and untouched demos (ja-phio, ja-morgan, ja-nova) gave no answer within 20 s.
fence: The real provision door over a held fake run. Not exercised: provision.sh, fleet01's load.
